newsitem.title: UK: Conoco sees first N.Sea MacCulloch oil mid-May.
newsitem.headline: Conoco sees first N.Sea MacCulloch oil mid-May.

text.p: Conoco said on Monday it expected first oil to flow from its new North Sea MacCulloch field around the middle of next month.
The start of production, originally due in December 1996, will follow 40 days of commissioning which started when the floating production vessel North Sea Producer arrived at the field on Sunday.
Conoco is a unit of U.S.-based DuPont.

MacCulloch, which has estimated recoverable reserves of 58 million barrels of crude oil similar to North Sea benchmark Brent, should see peak production hit 50-60,000 barrels per day (bpd) maintaining that level for 15-18 months.
Operator Conoco holds a 60 percent interest in MacCulloch. LASMO North Sea Plc owns the remaining 40 percent.
